market.question: Will Ethereum dip to $1,500 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: ETH spot at ~$2,250-2,300 on April 30. To dip to $1,500 by Dec 31, 2026 requires a ~33-35% drawdown over ~8 months. ETH has historically had higher volatility than BTC and underperformed it in this cycle, so a sub-$1,500 print is plausible — base rate suggests 35-45%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: ETH's relative strength versus BTC and macro risk-off dynamics.
